description: Dedicated pages for Kaysender fall-prevention devices.

entries.title: Air Sailor's Rope Harness
entries.summary: A reinforced body harness and enchanted tether anchors working sailors to decks and rigging.
body: Leather, canvas, adjustable straps, quick-release buckles, a heavy clasp, and an alchemically treated forty-foot rope make this standard fleet safety equipment. Stormproof, grappling, and mageweave upgrades address lightning, distant anchoring, and magical hovering.
Many crews mandate harness use and treat lost harnesses as bad omens.

sections.heading: Legacy Equipment Rules
body: The source gives prices, tether distances, check benefits, resistance, grappling ranges, and hover duration. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Sky Bloon Harness
entries.summary: A cheap backpack balloon uses ignited float-fish oil to slow a manually triggered fall.
body: Canvas, enchanted resin, float-fish oil, and spark powder inflate a reusable buoyant balloon. It can provide hours of flotation after quick activation but may not arrest an extreme fall.

sections.heading: Legacy Performance
body: Activation time, fall reduction, and flotation duration require conversion.

entries.title: Feather Charms
entries.summary: Cheap priest-blessed wooden feathers provide brief slow-fall and hovering protection before their magic expires.
body: Street vendors sell locally made tokens that must be held or pinned to clothing. Their short-lived enchantment can carry a falling person toward a platform or useful current, but renewal practices differ between settlements.

sections.heading: Legacy Duration
body: The source gives conflicting second-, round-, and day-scale durations that require reconciliation during conversion.

entries.title: Cloudcatch Cloak
entries.summary: A bulky enchanted cloak automatically cushions a fall and offers limited gliding and an emergency upward launch.
body: Alchemy guilds produce the cloak for merchants, soldiers, and adventurers. A blast-powder tube at the neck powers a one-use launch and must be refilled afterward.

sections.heading: Legacy Performance
body: Fall rate and launch distance require conversion.

entries.title: Levitation Safety Band
entries.summary: A silver bracelet halts descent in place and displays its remaining magical charge.
body: The band is reliable but provides no lateral movement, so a stranded wearer still needs rescue or another way to reach solid ground. A bright green bar reports remaining time.

sections.heading: Legacy Duration
body: The source states a sixty-hour duration requiring balance and conversion review.

entries.title: Sky Whistle
entries.summary: A magical whistle summons a small air elemental compelled to carry its user to the nearest solid ground.
body: Elemental summoners craft the device. It is dependable and can sustain a journey lasting days, but the user needs a free hand and has no control over which nearby ground the slow elemental selects.

entries.title: Parachuting Wyrm Kit
entries.summary: A compact magical container unfolds into a wyrm-shaped gliding harness with limited propulsion.
body: Popular with adventurers, the expanding glider can change elevation and steer toward safety. A visible throat container holds its propulsion charge, but deployment takes precious time during freefall.

sections.heading: Legacy Propulsion
body: The source gives a one-day charge and an elevation rate requiring conversion.

entries.title: Featherlight Parasol
entries.summary: An ornate automatic parasol gives aristocrats a stylish, sustained slow descent.
body: The parasol remains active while deployed and makes a fall graceful, but its fragile construction is poorly suited to combat or violent weather.

entries.title: Phoenix Pendant
entries.summary: A phoenix-feather pendant conjures a fiery rescuer that rapidly carries its wearer toward solid ground.
body: Master enchanters create the expensive pendant. After use its trapped feather violently strains against the damaged setting, which must be recharged and resealed before it escapes into the ether.

sections.heading: Legacy Rescue Speed
body: The source gives a round-based movement rate requiring conversion.

entries.title: Aether Wings Harness
entries.summary: A gilded custom harness unfolds luminous magical wings for prolonged controlled flight.
body: Enchanted stones, glowing script, parchment streamers, and an elaborate backpack make the device conspicuous and extremely costly. Royalty and elite adventurers rely on expert artificers to maintain its charge.

sections.heading: Legacy Flight Duration
body: The source states up to seven continuous days of flight per charge. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Eternal Drift Boots
entries.summary: Attuned luxury boots stop a fall and permit controlled hovering for a limited period.
body: Premier magical artisans make the elegant boots for a single bonded wearer. Their reliability and style are offset by attunement and restricted availability.

entries.title: Skyweaver's Sphere
entries.summary: An ancient crystal creates a long-lasting floating platform beneath a falling user.
body: Attributed to the First Sky Mages, the priceless sphere offers stable midair rest and time to plan a rescue. Surviving examples are nearly impossible to reproduce.

sections.heading: Legacy Duration
body: The source states the platform persists for up to ten days. Conversion is required.

entries.title: The Abyssal Amulet
entries.summary: A black, chalk-like token crumbles to ash while teleporting its bearer toward the nearest safe surface.
body: Legends describe figurines, coins, tokens, and amulets thrumming with otherworldly power. Activation is immediate and usually reliable, but may displace the rescued person miles from their intended destination.
